title: Notes

title: Software
text:
CoreSpecViewer
An open tool for working with hyperspectral drill-core imagery, from raw-data processing through visualisation, spectral exploration and downhole products.
CoreSpecViewer repo


python-tetracorder
A port of the rules and evaluation logic of the Tetracorder algorithm to pure Python - with no guarantee or warranty!
python-tetracorder repo
This is merely a translation of the expertise encoded in the phenomenal Tetracorder expert system. All citation and credit should go to: Roger N. Clark, Gregg A. Swayze, K. Eric Livo, Raymond F. Kokaly, Steve J. Sutley, J. Brad Dalton, Robert R. McDougal and Carol A. Gent, 2003, Imaging spectroscopy: Earth and planetary remote sensing with the USGS Tetracorder and expert systems, Journal of Geophysical Research, Vol 108.

title: Russell Rogers: Things not worth a paper
text:
I have a background in geology, and have become a bit fanatical about hyperspectral imagery, particularly core scanning.
This site will serve three purposes:
I have a degree in geology from the University of Leicester and an MSc from INRS, Université du Québec. I have worked in geoscience since 2010 and currently work at Geological Survey Ireland.
The opinions and positions expressed on this site are wholly my own.
